faq.question: Do you help with roof insurance claims after a storm?
faq.answer: Yes. We perform a post-storm inspection, provide emergency tarping when needed, and document all damage with photos and reports so your insurance adjuster has what they need to process the claim quickly.

faq.question: Are your roofs hurricane and HVHZ rated?
faq.answer: Absolutely. Every system we install meets or exceeds Florida's High-Velocity Hurricane Zone (HVHZ) building codes, with components rated for the high wind speeds South Florida sees during hurricane season.

faq.question: What roofing materials do you install?
faq.answer: We install concrete and clay tile, standing seam and metal roofing, architectural asphalt shingles, and commercial flat-roof systems (TPO, PVC, and modified bitumen) based on your property and budget.

faq.question: Do you provide free estimates and inspections?
faq.answer: Yes. Every project starts with a free roof inspection and a same-day estimate, with a clear, written scope so you know exactly what is included.

faq.question: How fast can you respond to an emergency roof leak?
faq.answer: We answer calls 24/7 and provide same-day emergency response across Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach with temporary protection to stop water intrusion until a full repair can be scheduled.

faq.question: Are you licensed and insured in Florida?
faq.answer: Yes. Basile Contractors is a licensed and fully insured South Florida roofing contractor, and we back our work with manufacturer warranties and workmanship coverage.
